metadata.article_title: Freedom as to payment of taxes for promotion of any particular religion

article.title: Freedom as to payment of taxes for promotion of any particular religion
article.content:
27Freedom as to payment of taxes for promotion of any particular religion

Article 27 · Part III · Right to Freedom of Religion
No person shall be compelled to pay any taxes, the proceeds of which are specifically appropriated in payment of expenses for the promotion or maintenance of any particular religion or religious denomination.
